commands=[]
for line in err.decode().splitlines():
 if 'Running `' not in line or '--crate-name ' not in line:continue
 cmd=shlex.split(line.split('Running `',1)[1].rsplit('`',1)[0]);crate=cmd[cmd.index('--crate-name')+1];fs=sorted(cmd[i+1][len('feature='):].strip('"') for i,x in enumerate(cmd[:-1]) if x=='--cfg' and cmd[i+1].startswith('feature='));externs={cmd[i+1].split('=',1)[0]:cmd[i+1].split('=',1)[1] for i,x in enumerate(cmd[:-1]) if x=='--extern'};commands.append({'crate':crate,'command':cmd,'active_features':fs,'externs':externs,'raw_line':line})
if a.label.startswith('codec'):
 cs=[c for c in commands if c['crate']=='aspis_statement'];assert len(cs)==1 and cs[0]['active_features']==['pool-v1-kernel','r0'];assert 'aspis_prover' not in cs[0]['externs'];assert not any(c['crate'] in ['aspis_r1_cost_probe','aspis_prover'] for c in commands);assert out==(r/'baselines/codec1233.stdout.log').read_bytes();assert re.findall(rb'^case (\d+)$',out,re.M)==[str(i).encode() for i in range(1233)] and out.endswith(b'complete 1233\n');proof={'cases':1233,'complete_stdout_bytes_identical':True,'bytes':len(out),'sha256':sha(out),'prover_status':'No cost-probe/prover dependency in codec target; selected statement features/externs recorded.'};primary=cs
elif a.label.startswith('counter'):
 cs=[c for c in commands if c['crate']=='aspis_r1_cost_probe'];assert len(cs)==1 and cs[0]['active_features']==['default','private-leaf-salts'];assert 'aspis_prover' not in cs[0]['externs'];current=json.loads((r/'ordered-counter-no-prover.json').read_text());old=json.loads((r/'baselines/counter583.json').read_text());assert current['source_revision']==receipt['source_revision'];assert len(current['ordered_digest_calls'])==583 and current['ordered_digest_calls']==old['ordered_digest_calls'];assert current['acceptance']==old['acceptance'];assert current['hash_input_counts']['tx1_raw_calls']==349 and current['hash_input_counts']['tx2_raw_calls']==234;proof={'ordered_calls':583,'tx1':349,'tx2':234,'phase_input_answer_order_identical':True,'checkpoint_bytes_and_acceptance_identical':True,'output_sha256':sha((r/'ordered-counter-no-prover.json').read_bytes())};primary=cs
else:
 cs=[c for c in commands if c['crate']=='aspis_r1_cost_probe'];pr=[c for c in commands if c['crate']=='aspis_r1_cost_probe_program'];assert len(cs)==len(pr)==1;assert cs[0]['active_features']==['default','optimized-terminal','private-leaf-salts'];assert 'aspis_prover' not in cs[0]['externs'];assert pr[0]['active_features']==['custom-heap','default','pool-adapter','private-leaf-salts'];assert '--test' in pr[0]['command'];pat=rb'^test (r1_pool_adapter::checkpoint_tests::\S+) \.\.\. ok$';names=re.findall(pat,out,re.M);oldnames=re.findall(pat,(r/'baselines/checkpoint23.stdout.log').read_bytes(),re.M);assert len(names)==23 and names==oldnames;assert b'test result: ok. 23 passed; 0 failed;' in out;proof={'tests':23,'test_names_exactly_match_accepted':[n.decode() for n in names],'all_passed':True};primary=cs+pr
result={'status':'PASS_DECISION1G_NATIVE_GATE','label':a.label,'source_revision':receipt['source_revision'],'receipt_sha256':sha((run/'receipt.json').read_bytes()),'source_pins_sha256':m['source_pins_sha256'],'input_manifest_sha256':receipt['input_manifest_sha256'],'proof':proof,'actual_compiler_features_and_externs':primary,'metrics':{k:receipt[k] for k in ['exit_status','wall_seconds','peak_rss_kib','process_swaps','limits']},'axioms':'N/A: Rust/native gate; no Lean result'};dest=r/(a.label+'-comparison.json');dest.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'label':a.label,'proof':proof,'metrics':result['metrics']},sort_keys=True))
